title: Releasing the directions

sandhi.rule: the visarga of bhūr (an r-stem) is r before a voiced sound
the visarga of suvar is r before a vowel

translation.literal: “Bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar om” — thus the release of the directions.
translation.readable: With bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar om the directions are released.

meaning: After the japa the protective binding of the directions made at the end of the aṅga-nyāsa (dig-bandha, ‘binding the directions’) is undone with the same words, bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar om. The Mylapore prayoga repeats the whole aṅga-nyāsa before this line; this record covers the closing line, which names the act.
in_the_rite: Step japa, all three services, after the Gāyatrī japa (in the Mylapore prayoga only).

notes.label: traditional
notes.text: The pair dig-bandha / dig-vimoka belongs to the nyāsa practice that the Mylapore prayoga adds to the japa; S has neither.
